name: Fixed-Horizon Thicket-Maximum Classes
summary: Finite Boolean classes attaining the thicket Sauer bound at a specified horizon and Littlestone-dimension bound.
parameters: Horizon t and Littlestone bound d, under the hypothesis Ldim(H) <= d.
comments: The property is horizon-dependent. A finite positive-dimensional class cannot attain the bound for arbitrarily large horizons.
